in_hebrew.name: Sawyer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sawyer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word ‘sigeweorca’ meaning ‘victorious worker’ or ‘worker of the highest significance’. The name Sawyer was given to those who worked with wood, particularly those who cut timber or made saws.
